stem.text: The diagram shows visible light incident normally on a diffraction grating.

stem.alt: Diagram, marked not to scale: parallel incident light arrows approach a vertical diffraction grating from the left. A dashed centre line runs horizontally from the grating to a vertical screen on the right. A ray from the grating meets the screen at a point labelled centre of fourth order intensity maximum, and the angle between the ray and the centre line is marked 53 degrees.

stem.text: A pattern of intensity maxima forms on the screen. A line connecting the centre of the fourth order intensity maximum with the centre of the diffraction grating forms an angle of $53^{\circ}$ with the centre line. The grating has a line spacing of $2.7 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}$.
